title: Online Betting: How It Sickened and Indebted Brazilians
seoTitle: How betting sickened and indebted Brazilians
subtitle: Understanding the impact of betting on public health and personal finances
excerpt: At 42, Kaio feels relieved by the ban on online betting platforms and the refund of balances to users.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Kaio, 42, described a feeling of relief upon hearing the news released last Friday (25th) that online betting platforms have been banned in the country and that the return of balances to bettors will be mandated.

The measure is a response to a scenario where gambling has been identified as a driver of illness and rising debt among Brazilians, bringing negative consequences for both health and family financial stability.

With the ban, the government aims to reverse the harmful effects of online betting by returning withheld funds to users, thereby easing the burden of accumulated debt for those who got involved in gambling.

With information from Agência Brasil.
